PROBE ticket. Disposable. Created to exercise the LIVE rebar MCP server end-to-end.

## Context / Problem
The live MCP server at rebar.solutions.navateam.com needs an end-to-end smoke exercise of its
write surface. This ticket is the probe subject; it carries no production value and is closed
as obsolete when the exercise finishes.

## Approach
Drive create/show/search/list/comment/edit/link/unlink/claim/transition/reopen against the
live endpoint and record anomalies as separate bug tickets.

## Scope
- In scope: this probe ticket only.
- Out of scope: any repository file change.

## Testing
No repository files change, so there is nothing to test; no_file_impact is declared.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] AC1: The MCP write surface is exercised against the live server.
- [x] AC2: Anomalies found are filed as separate bug tickets.
- [x] AC3: This probe is closed as obsolete.

## Definition of Done
- [x] DD1: Probe closed with close_class=obsolete.
